title: Minimum Moves To Make Array Complementary
statement:
An even-length array is complementary when every mirrored pair has the same sum. In one move, replace any value with an integer from `1` through `limit`. Return the minimum moves needed to make the array complementary.

## Examples

```text
Input: nums = [1, 2, 4, 3], limit = 4
Output: 1
```

```text
Input: nums = [1, 2, 2, 1], limit = 2
Output: 2
```

```text
Input: nums = [1, 2, 1, 2], limit = 2
Output: 0
```

## Constraints

- `2 <= nums.length <= 10^5`; its length is even.
- `1 <= nums[i] <= limit <= 10^5`
